description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PP/25/04416 to allow a limited scope of work to be undertaken in advance of the wider development. The scope of work comprises the excavation of a small trench and the installation of a section of ducting and pipework associated with the site's future water connection - this requires amendments to Condition 2 (Compliance with Approved Drawings), Condition 14 (Archaeology), Condition 15 (Considerate Constructors Scheme (CCS)), Condition 16 (Code of Construction Practice), Condition 24 (Demolition Traffic Management Plan), Condition 25 (Construction Traffic Management Plan), Condition 26 (Professional Management of Engineering Works), Condition 31 (Protection of Trees During Demolition and Construction), Condition 49 (Air Quality Dust Monitoring) and Condition 63 (Preliminary Risk Assessment and Proposed Intrusive Site Investigation Design).
site_name: Lots Road South formed by Chelsea Creek Car Pound Lots Road, 65-69 and 71-73 Lots Road, LONDON, SW10 0RN
